title: Blow-up domains η_{x,λ_i}(U) eventually contain every bounded set
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P = Euclid P, every x ∈ U, every sequence (λ_i)_{i∈ℕ} of reals with λ_i > 0 for all i and λ_i → 0, and every bounded set K ⊆ ℝ^P (Bornology.IsBounded K): for all sufficiently large i, K ⊆ η_{x,λ_i}(U), where η_{x,λ}(y) = λ^{−1}(y − x) is Simon's dilation (Lean dilation x λ y = −(λ⁻¹ • x) + λ⁻¹ • y), i.e. ∀ᶠ i in atTop, K ⊆ dilation x (λ_i) '' U.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ), IsOpen U → x ∈ U → (∀ i, 0 < lams i) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), Bornology.IsBounded K → ∀ᶠ i in atTop, K ⊆ dilation x (lams i) '' U
